28 August 2026

University registration and selection for vacant places have begun

Registration through my.gov.az for students admitted to universities and specialization selection for remaining vacant university places have begun, with key deadlines on September 2 and September 8.

Two important stages of Azerbaijan's 2026 higher-education admissions process have begun.

Electronic registration for applicants admitted to bachelor's degree programs began at 11:00 on August 28 and will remain open until 18:00 on September 8. Registration is conducted exclusively through the my.gov.az platform.

Applicants should log in to their personal accounts using mygov ID, select the Ministry of Science and Education under the Services section and access the service for registration of students at higher and secondary specialized education institutions.

Applicants who do not complete registration through the relevant service and receive confirmation from their educational institution may be removed from the list of admitted students.

At the same time, specialization selection for vacant places at higher education institutions and colleges based on complete 11-year secondary education is being conducted from August 28 until 23:59 on September 2.

Eligible applicants may enter and confirm up to 20 specialization codes in their preferred order in the electronic application.

Applicants who have already been admitted to a higher education institution are not eligible to participate in the competition for remaining vacant university places and colleges.

Applicants are advised to complete the relevant registration or specialization-selection process before the deadlines and verify the status of their applications.
